description: This file contains unit tests for the HibernateDiagnosisDAO class in the OpenMRS project. It tests CRUD operations and queries related to Diagnosis entities, ensuring proper persistence and retrieval from the database.

classes.name: HibernateDiagnosisDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the HibernateDiagnosisDAO implementation, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for integration testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method runs by loading a predefined dataset.

methods.name: shouldSaveDiagnosis
methods.description: Verifies that a Diagnosis entity can be successfully saved and retrieved, checking all relevant fields.

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a Diagnosis entity by its UUID.

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosisById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a Diagnosis entity by its internal database ID.

methods.name: shouldGetActiveDiagnosesWithFromDate
methods.description: Tests fetching active diagnoses for a patient with a specific 'from' date filter.

methods.name: shouldGetActiveDiagnosesWithDifferentFromDate
methods.description: Tests fetching active diagnoses for a patient with a different 'from' date to ensure filtering works.

methods.name: shouldGetActiveDiagnosesWithoutFromDate
methods.description: Checks fetching all active diagnoses without date filtering.

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of diagnoses associated with specific encounters.

methods.name: shouldGetPrimaryDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of primary diagnoses for specific encounters.

methods.name: shouldGetConfirmedDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Checks filtering diagnoses by confirmation status within encounters.

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of diagnoses associated with specific visits.

methods.name: shouldGetPrimaryDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of primary diagnoses for specific visits.

methods.name: shouldGetConfirmedDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Checks filtering diagnoses by confirmation status within visits.

methods.name: shouldDeleteDiagnosis
methods.description: Tests deleting a diagnosis and verifying it no longer exists.
